prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: deep magenta. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: the bare building; a torn-paper arrow.
Opens on the bare building, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: A torn-paper arrow drops down the face of the building and stops low.
Ends holding on the down arrow.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "SHARE PRICE DECLINE".

COPY LIST: "SHARE PRICE DECLINE". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Second, the share price decline suggests investor expectations have not been met.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage with refined 2D motion design. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a deep magenta flat block-color background. Centered is a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a neoclassical building, characterized by rough white torn-paper edges and a subtle drop shadow cast from an upper-left light source. A cream-colored paper chip overlay currently displays the text "CREDIBILITY AT RISK" in a bold, black sans-serif typeface. Immediately upon the first frame, the existing text chip vanishes and is replaced by a new cream-colored paper chip with the headline "SHARE PRICE DECLINE" printed in clean, stable black sans-serif typography. Simultaneously, a flat matte paper arrow, colored in a contrasting pale yellow with rough white torn edges, enters the frame from the top. The arrow drops rapidly down the face of the halftone building with a slight overshoot before snapping into a stable, downward-pointing position near the bottom of the building. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. Every element maintains a flat matte printed paper texture with visible print dots and small tape pieces. The composition holds steady on the downward arrow and the headline "SHARE PRICE DECLINE" for the final two seconds, with a very subtle, rhythmic bobbing motion to create a loop.

overall_soundscape: A warm, clear English narrator (S1), male, middle-aged, with a natural and brisk delivery, says <d>[English] Second, the share price decline suggests investor expectations have not been met.</d> Synchronized with the narrator's speech and the visual movement, there are crisp, tactile diegetic sounds of a paper slap and the sticky peel of adhesive tape.
